caption: The drawing features a single ornate rectangular frame with an empty center, rendered in a reddish-brown wood tone with elaborate gold-colored detailing. The frame’s edges are scalloped and decorated with gold ornamental flourishes, with additional gold leaf motifs on the sides and bottom corners. The top of the frame is crowned with a gold-colored sculpted bird standing on a pedestal, flanked by flower decorations on either side. At the top left, there is a small inset diagram showing a line drawing of the same frame with measurements labeled: 50" in height, 27½" in width, and an inner space marked as 30" high by 18" wide. The drawing is set against a plain, off-white background, with a thin red border enclosing the main composition. Near the lower right edge, the text “DEL. 2591 James M. Lawson” is present.
title: Mirror - Chippendale Style
